caption: The benchmark’s prompt, sent from the agent panel: frontier 262K reads AIME 2026 problem 14 and thinks, the readout under it showing its speed and its context.
It runs Python in the folder’s container to compute and check; each step folds into one line of the panel.
In auto mode, each file the agent writes opens beside you as a change: here its first check script.
Twenty minutes in, its ninth script: 62K of the 262K context used, 57K attended on the GPU, the rest retrieved from RAM.
After 24 minutes it writes the answer, 681, which is right.
The same session in the panel, its math drawn, and in OpenCode’s terminal: 74K of context, 24 minutes.
